audience: businesses that take bookings in Reservio, such as salons, clinics and studios

useCases.title: Find open slots for a service next week
useCases.text: Pick a service and a date range. See which days have an open slot and the exact start times, for all staff or for one person.

useCases.title: Poll for the newest bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings sorted by creation time, newest first. Read the client name, state and cost of each one to spot new bookings.

useCases.title: Check who works on a given day
useCases.text: Read the staff members and their rosters for a date. Compare them with the opening hours of the business.

useCases.title: Book a client into an open appointment slot
useCases.text: Find an open slot for a service, then create the appointment booking for the client. Reservio may notify the client.

useCases.title: Add a client to a group event
useCases.text: Find the days with open group events, pick the event and book the client into it. Reservio may notify the client.
